name: Val Cenis
description: Val Cenis links the traditional villages of Lanslebourg, Lanslevillard, and Termignon in the Haute Maurienne valley. 125km of pistes rising to 2,800m. The signature run is L'Escargot — one of the longest green runs in Europe at 10km. First French resort to invest in an electric snow groomer (local hydroelectric power). First resort with 96% undeveloped land. 6-day pass gives 1 free day in 5 neighbouring resorts (350km total). 200km of cross-country. 4.5 million litres of milk produced locally for Beaufort cheese.

overview.atmosphere: Authentic Haute Maurienne villages (Lanslebourg, Lanslevillard, Termignon) sharing 125km of sunny, uncrowded pistes. Europe's longest green run (L'Escargot, 10km). Best value in the Maurienne. Electric snow groomer — first in France.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Le 1480 — 6 bowling lanes, bar lounge, games room, sports TV, restaurant, free WiFi. Open 9:30am-1am.. Single-screen cinemas in both Lanslevillard and Lanslebourg. Open every night except Saturday.. Snowshoeing, ski touring, heritage walks, electric mountain biking, Nordic skiing (200km), Vanoise National Park

honest_drawbacks: Very quiet apres — settles down early
